scope: Rear photo mode, 1x, fixed still life, original plus all 19 stock filters, real preview and 4096x3072 JPEG output. No app source changes or unrelated feature regressions.

off_restoration.catalog_evidence: Native log prefix has 19 entries before Android line truncation; last native item is both the actual preview filter and the visibly selected terminal menu item. Combined list matches native 20-entry catalog.

photo_comparison.method: PIL RGB images resized to 320x240, Gaussian blur 1.2px, whole-image translation search +/-2px at 160x120; RGB MAE and 4x3 grid normalized channel fractions. Descriptive comparisons, not calibrated colorimetry or statistical equivalence.

logs.limitations: Native capture LUT file-path traces were not emitted in this capture. Evidence combines native preview filter IDs, no module resource remaps, unmodified stock LUT hashes and paired real photos.
logs.menu_resource_note: Six added-style resource mappings occur while initializing the extended menu, before the first ON sample. No native filter name is remapped, no added filter ID appears in active full-preview observations, and no capture mapping occurs.

limitations: Automatic exposure, white balance, denoising and native filter grain are not deterministic; no pixel-identical claim.
Only this rear still-photo configuration was compared, not all lenses, modes, lighting or scene types.

Closing the feature requires camera process restart; original selection history is not saved, and an out-of-range added index is clamped by the OEM camera. User accepted restoration of native functionality.
